title: Per-Workbook Teacher Manual Generation
description: Generate project-level teacher manuals from workbook JSON data with step inserts, 4-period lesson plans, integrated bell-ringers, and blended learning guidance.
deviation_notes: Phase 9 surfaced a Paged.js rAF-chain freeze in real browsers (occluded-tab frame starvation); fixed via dual-arm frame-independent driver shim (708bed9). origins-2-a0: 14/14 lessons, 167 pages, print PDF verified. Compile <2s warm (<10s criterion met).
